department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: December 31, 2026 for first consideration for funding; February 28, 2027 for remaining funding.
deadline.quote: December 31, 2026 — 11:59 PM: First consideration for funding

also.quote: February 28, 2027 — 11:59 PM: Considered for remaining funding

fee_waiver.value: The department says fee and waiver policies are set by the university, which leaves waivers to departments.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fees and waiver policies are determined by the University.

gre_general.value: The department page does not mention the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The department page does not say whether a supervisor is needed before applying.

funding.value: Assistantships are awarded together with admission decisions, with funding priority for the December 31 deadline; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: Departmental assistantships are awarded in conjunction with admissions decisions.

entry_route.value: Direct admission to the PhD from a B.S. is possible, as is the traditional route after an M.S.
entry_route.quote: Direct-Admit Ph.D. (from B.S.): Minimum 30 graduate coursework credits plus 14 dissertation research credits.

also.quote: Traditional Ph.D. (post-M.S.): Minimum 18 graduate coursework credits plus 14 dissertation research credits.

notes: The department also runs a Nuclear Engineering PhD with a separate admissions page.
